verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a UI framework for building apps. It has no end-user collection of items for anyone to bulk-edit or bulk-act on. The evidence covers reactivity, stores, rendering and SSR, and none of it shows a user-facing bulk-operations capability, so this axis is a category mismatch for this kind of product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
